title: Explanation of the New System
summary: Leibniz clarifies the New System for its first readers: what the hypothesis asserts, what it denies, and why it saves the phenomena.
sourceNote: Seed text: G. M. Duncan, The Philosophical Works of Leibnitz (New Haven, 1908), translated from the French; OCR transcription from the archive.org scan (worksofleibniz00leibuoft), US public domain.
